description: This file contains the PHP class 'SaleCoupon', which is a controller for handling the sale coupon report extension in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for displaying reports, saving settings, and generating report data related to sale coupons.

classes.name: SaleCoupon
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the sale coupon report extension in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and displays the sale coupon report form page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report's configuration settings.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the main sale coupon report view with analysis.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of sale coupon report data in JSON format.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the report data as a string, filtered and paginated.
